title: 25级《英语》课程月考试题
notes: 根据用户提供的原始 DOC 整理；原卷未附参考答案，答案及解析待教师核对。
第16题无完全准确选项；第29、31题两句互换也可能通顺；第35题原卷漏印题号；第40题原卷未明确显示画线部分。
阅读 B 末尾出现与故事不相干的英文学习段落，按原卷保留。

context.text: PPE is short for personal protective equipment. PPE is used to protect employees from serious injury or illness caused by exposure to chemical, radiation, electrical equipment, human equipment, or mechanical equipment. It includes face mask, safety glasses, helmet, safety gloves, safety shoes, ear protector, respirator and safety belt.

The purpose of PPE management is to ensure the safety and health of employees in production, and reasonably equip personal protective equipment. Dust, noise, poison, high temperature rays, electromagnetic radiation, ect. can cause serious occupational diseases, such as electric shock, lifting injury, falling object, piercing, or acid-base burns may occur in a dangerous workplace. Each workplace must focus on strengthening the supervision and the management of the use of personal labor protective equipment to ensure the safety and health of employees. In case of damage of failure of production equipment and possible leakage of harmful and toxic gases in the workplace, each workshop shall place necessary anti-toxic protective equipment at the conspicuous part of the site for emergency use.

PPE management is mainly responsible for the development of monthly procurement plan, revision of labor protection equipment distribution standards and quality standards, responsible for supervising the equipment and the use of labor insurance supplies.

It was the day before Christmas. Della had only one dollar and eighty-seven cents to buy a gift for her husband Jim. She had saved the money for months by carefully saving every coin. She wanted to get him something nice and useful, but she knew it was not enough for a really good gift. They lived in a small old house. Life was hard for them, but they loved each other deeply and cared for each other warmly.

Della had long, beautiful brown hair. It was the best thing she had. She took good care of it every day. Jim had a gold watch. It came from his father and grandfather, so it was his greatest and most valuable treasure.

Della wanted to buy a special gold chain for Jim's watch. But she had no more money. She thought and thought, and tears came to her eyes. At last, she had a brave idea. She went to a shop and sold her beautiful long hair. With the money, she bought the perfect watch chain at once.
When Jim came home, he looked at Della quietly and felt very surprised. "What's wrong with you?" Della asked gently.
Jim smiled softly and said, "I sold my watch to buy a set of beautiful combs for your lovely hair."

They both smiled through tears. They gave up their most favorite things for each other. Their true love and kind hearts were the best Christmas gift of all. Besides this, I often read English stories, jokes and easy novels. They help me understand a lot of things. So to do more reading is an important way to learn English well. And I also write English diaries. English has become a close friend of mine.

Manufacturing industry usually adopts the working mode of three shifts, which refers to the early shift, the swing shift and the late shift. Each period lasts for eight hours. These three shifts should fully describe the responsibilities of each shift and establish a strict exchange shift system. The output and quality completed in three shifts should be separately recorded for acceptance and assessment, so as to clarify the responsibilities of workers in each shift and make them concerned. This maximizes production while avoiding long hours for workers.

For professionals like doctors, security guards and factory workers, late shift is inevitable (不可避免的). The three shift workers can easily get tired at night and are more likely to make mistakes. They are not only irritable, but also suffers from heart disease. The problem is how to minimise the phenomena of the lack of sleep, and minimize the impact of shifts on life and physical health.
第三题 补全对话（共5小题；每小题2分，满分10分）
阅读下列对话，从所给选项中，选出能够完成对话的最佳选项，选项中有两个多余选项。
A: Long time no see. Where do you work now?
A: Are you a salesman？
B: No, I'm not. 　____ (29)
A: Is the work heavy?
B: A bit.
B: I think so. How about you?
A: I work in a factory. 　____ (31)
B: Are you busy?
A: Yes. 　____ (32)　  Of course, our salary is very good.
B: That's great.

questions.stem: I want to be _______ electrician in the future.
questions.reason: 选B：an。electrician意为电工，以元音音素/ɪ/开头，泛指未来成为“一名电工”用an。be后表示职业的单数可数名词通常不能裸用；此处尚未特指某位电工，不用the。

questions.stem: Could you tell me ______ now?
questions.reason: 选B：where he lives。tell me后的宾语从句要用陈述语序，不能保留where does/did he live的疑问倒装。Could you …是礼貌请求，不表示从句必须过去时；now问现在住哪儿，故用lives。

questions.stem: A healthy diet can ______ the risk of heart disease.
questions.reason: 选C：reduce。reduce the risk of heart disease表示降低心脏病风险，与healthy diet有益健康相符。help是帮助，encourage是鼓励，support是支持，均不能在此直接表达把风险降低的意思；can后接原形reduce。

questions.stem: We heard someone ______ loudly in the next room while we were working.
questions.reason: 选C：shouting。hear sb doing sth强调听见某人正在做某事，while we were working提供当时工作的背景，因此“听见隔壁正在大声喊叫”最贴切。hear sb do可表示听到整个过程，to shout不能用于这一主动感官动词结构。

questions.stem:
— It is my first time travelling all by myself. I'm so worried.
— ______. There is plenty of information online.
questions.reason: 选A：Take it easy（别紧张）。对方第一次独自旅行感到担心，后句说网上有丰富信息，意在安慰。Try harder next time用于鼓励下次努力，Thank you all the same用于仍表感谢，I can't agree more表示非常赞同，均不对应焦虑求安慰。

questions.stem: Jack is _______ shy_________ introduce himself to new people.
questions.reason: 选C：too; to。too shy to introduce himself表示太害羞而无法向陌生人介绍自己。enough若修饰shy须放后面，so … that后应接完整从句，not only … but also应连接并列成分，都不能放进本题给定语序。

questions.stem: Don't be afraid ________ your mother-in-law.
questions.reason: 选A：to meet。be afraid to do sth表示因害怕而不敢做某事，本句劝对方不要怕见岳母/婆婆。be afraid of doing也成立，但选项和空前均没有of，不能直接把meeting接在afraid后。

questions.stem: Either you or he ______ to clean the room every day.
questions.reason: 选A：has。either … or …连接主语时，谓语通常遵循就近一致，最近的he为第三人称单数，所以has to clean。every day说明日常要求，用一般现在时；having不能独立作此处谓语，had不符合日常现在语境。

questions.stem: Great changes ______ in my hometown in the past few years.
questions.reason: 选B：have taken place。in the past few years表示截至现在的过去几年，通常用现在完成时；主语changes为复数，用have。take place意为发生，不用于被动，因此其他三个含被动结构的选项均不成立。

questions.stem: _______ we don't work overtime, we_____ finish the task within the date of delivery.
questions.reason: 选A：If; won't。句意是“如果不加班，就不能在交货期内完成任务”，If引导条件，主句用won't finish表将来结果。从句we don't是一般现在时。Unless自带“如果不”，再接don't会把条件意思反转；When和Because也不及If贴合这里的假设。

questions.stem: Get the_________ food material ready and follow the cooking procedures.
questions.reason: 选B：required。required food material表示所需食材，material与require之间是被动关系，用过去分词作定语。requiring表示主动要求，require是动词原形，requirement是名词，均不能这样表达“被需要的”食材。

questions.stem: It is because he is ill ______ he can't come to school.
questions.reason: 选C：that。这是It is + 被强调部分 + that …强调句，被强调的是because he is ill这个原因状语。去掉It is和that可还原为He can't come to school because he is ill；不能因强调原因就把that换成why。

questions.stem: If there ______ no buying and selling of animals, there ______ no killing.
questions.reason: 选C：is; will be。if从句表示将来条件，用一般现在时there is；主句表达将来结果，用there will be。buying and selling of animals在此作为交易行为整体看待；不要把主句will机械复制进if从句。

questions.stem: There is more space in the high-speed train and the travel becomes more ____-
questions.reason: 选D：comfortable。高铁空间更大，旅途因而更舒适，comfortable的比较级是more comfortable。serious是严肃的，boring是无聊的，dangerous是危险的，均不合more space所支持的积极效果。

questions.stem: The factory must strengthen safety education, ________ more safety accidents will arise.
questions.reason: 选C：or。句意是工厂必须加强安全教育，“否则”会发生更多事故，or在这里表示不采取前述措施的后果。so表示因此，because表示因为，unless表示除非，都不能直接连接成这里所需的否则关系。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 A
questions.stem: According to the passage, what is PPE?

options.text: PPE is short for Philosophy，Politics and Economics.
PPE is short for protective personal equipment.
PPE is short for Polypheylene ethe.
PPE is short for Property, Plant and Equipment.

questions.reason: 本题无完全准确选项。首段将PPE展开为personal protective equipment（个人防护装备）；B把personal和protective的顺序颠倒，只是最接近，并非准确答案。A、C、D对应其他词组，不是本文所指；保留待核对，不按B唯一计分。
questions.examNote: 原卷选项没有与原文完全一致的答案；B 为最接近的选项，本题待确认且不计分。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 A
questions.stem: Which one of the following is NOT included in the PPE?
questions.reason: 选C：Mobile phone。题目问NOT included，须选不在列举中的物品。第一段列出safety belt、helmet、respirator等防护装备，却没有手机；手机也不是该清单中的个人防护用品，不能忽略NOT反向作答。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 A
questions.stem: What can we see is harmful to people's health?
questions.reason: 选D：All of above。第二段列举Dust、noise、high temperature rays等可能损害健康的因素，A、B、C三项均在列表中。因此选包含三者的D，不应看到首个符合项目就提前结束查找。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 A
questions.stem: Through the passage, we know PPE management is very ______ for an enterprise.
questions.reason: 选A：necessary。全文反复强调PPE管理是为了保障员工安全与健康，还列出监督、标准和应急装备要求，说明它对企业必要。dangerous描述危险而非管理的重要性，interesting和impressive也没有相应论据。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 B
questions.stem: When did the story happen?
questions.reason: 选C：The day before Christmas。故事开头直接给出It was the day before Christmas，即圣诞节前一天。On Christmas Day是圣诞当天，the day after是之后一天；不要把买圣诞礼物就等同于故事发生在圣诞当天。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 B
questions.stem: How did Della get the money for Jim's gift?

options.text: She asked her friends for help.

questions.reason: 选A：She sold her beautiful hair。第三段写Della去商店卖掉长发，With the money再买表链，因果链直接回答钱从哪里来。此前虽攒过钱，但金额不够，而且原文是for months，D的for years也不符。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 B
questions.stem: What was Jim's most valuable treasure?
questions.reason: 选B：His gold watch。第二段说Jim的金表传自父亲、祖父，是his greatest and most valuable treasure。combs是他后来为Della买的礼物，gold chain是Della给他的礼物，不能把送出的礼物与原本珍藏混淆。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 B
questions.stem: What can we learn from the story?

options.text: True love is the best gift.

questions.reason: 选C：True love is the best gift。夫妻各卖掉最珍爱的东西为对方买礼物，末段直接把true love and kind hearts称为最好的圣诞礼物。昂贵礼物或金钱至上都与故事主旨相反，也不能把互相牺牲解读成单纯劝人别卖东西。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 C
questions.stem: What does the working mode of three shifts include?
questions.reason: 选D：All of above。阅读C首句把three shifts明确分为early shift、swing shift、late shift，分别对应早班、中班、晚班。A、B、C各是其中一班，题目问整个三班制包含什么，要选三者兼有的D。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 C
questions.stem: How long does each shift last?
questions.reason: 选C：8 hours。第一段Each period lasts for eight hours直接说明每班八小时。三班合计可覆盖一天24小时，但题目each shift问单班时长，不能把24小时总覆盖时间当成每个人一班的工作时间。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 C
questions.stem: What does the working mode of three shifts exist for?

options.text: For making more money for workers.
For avoiding long hours for workers.

questions.reason: 选B：For avoiding long hours for workers。第一段结尾说This maximizes production while avoiding long hours for workers，B对应避免个人连续长时间工作。A的多赚钱、C的保护机器、D的工人需求均非这句话明确列出的目的。

questions.section: 第二题 阅读理解 C
questions.stem: According to the passage, which one of the following is TRUE?

options.text: Workers feel more tired when they are on the early shift.
The working mode of three shifts only exists in manufacturing industry.
Each shift has its own responsibilities.
Night shift don't affect workers' life and physical health。

questions.reason: 选C：Each shift has its own responsibilities。第一段要求fully describe the responsibilities of each shift，与C对应。A把夜班疲劳移到早班；B用only排除医生等文中职业；D否认夜班对身心影响，都违背原文。

questions.stem: 选择填入第 28 空的句子。

options.text: I repair the engines of motor vehicles.
Are you happy with your work?
I work in an auto 4S shop.

questions.reason: 选C：I work in an auto 4S shop。前句问Where do you work now，回答应是工作地点；4S店恰好提供地点，后面再问是否销售员，话题自然延续。职业或具体维修内容适合后续位置，不直接回答Where。

questions.stem: 选择填入第 29 空的句子。

options.text: I repair the engines of motor vehicles.
Are you happy with your work?
I work in an auto 4S shop.

questions.reason: 暂参考D：I am a mechanic。上句问Are you a salesman，先说No后补充“我是机械维修工”，形成职业对照。但A“我维修机动车发动机”也能解释不是销售员，且可与31空互换，因此本空保留多解待核对，不唯一判分。
questions.examNote: A、D 交换也可能语义通顺，参考答案需教师确认。

questions.stem: 选择填入第 30 空的句子。

options.text: I repair the engines of motor vehicles.
Are you happy with your work?
I work in an auto 4S shop.

questions.reason: 选B：Are you happy with your work?。下句I think so表示对某个判断的认同，适合回应“你对工作满意吗”，再以How about you转问对方。其他陈述或礼貌套语不能引出这里I think so的认可回答。

questions.stem: 选择填入第 31 空的句子。

options.text: I repair the engines of motor vehicles.
Are you happy with your work?
I work in an auto 4S shop.

questions.reason: 暂参考A：I repair the engines of motor vehicles。前面说在工厂工作，接着补充维修发动机的具体职责，再问是否忙碌，语义连贯。D“我是机械维修工”放此处也成立，与29空A、D可互换，因此不能把参考排序当成唯一答案。
questions.examNote: A、D 交换也可能语义通顺，参考答案需教师确认。

questions.stem: 选择填入第 32 空的句子。

options.text: I repair the engines of motor vehicles.
Are you happy with your work?
I work in an auto 4S shop.

questions.reason: 选F：We are always busy。前句Are you busy问是否忙，Yes之后进一步说明总是忙碌，随后补充工资很好，构成工作状况介绍。E、G是感谢或回应请求，不承接忙不忙；本空无需借29、31空的歧义说明代替解析。

questions.stem:
请将句子翻译成汉语。
Whether or not you need to wear a uniform depends on the company culture.
questions.answer: 是否需要穿制服取决于公司的企业文化。
questions.reason: Whether or not引导主语从句，意为“是否”，整个“是否需要穿制服”作depends on的主语。depend on译为取决于，company culture译为企业文化；全句译为“是否需要穿制服取决于公司的企业文化”，不要把whether译成条件“如果”。

questions.stem:
请将句子翻译成汉语。
To keep the factory running, we have to work in three shifts.
questions.answer: 为了让工厂保持运转，我们必须实行三班倒。
questions.reason: To keep …在句首表示目的“为了……”，keep the factory running是keep + 宾语 + -ing，指让工厂持续运转。have to表示必须，work in three shifts表示实行三班倒，不能把three shifts误译为工作三小时或转移三次。

questions.stem:
请将句子翻译成汉语。
Carelessness could lead to a serious accident.
questions.answer: 粗心可能导致严重事故。
questions.reason: Carelessness是名词“粗心”，作主语；could在此表示可能性，不必译成过去能够。lead to中的to是介词，后接a serious accident，意为导致严重事故。译文须保留“可能”，不能说粗心一定会导致事故。
questions.examNote: 原卷此句未印题号；按前后顺序补为 35。

questions.stem:
昨天一整天都在下雨，所以我们不得不待在家里。
It rained all day long yesterday, so we had to _____  _____ home.
questions.reason: 填stay at。stay at home表示待在家里，had to后接动词原形stay，不能再变stayed。yesterday表过去，过去时间已体现在had上；两空一词分别填stay、at，不把home前的介词漏掉。

questions.stem:
所有工人在车间都必须佩戴安全帽。
All workers are required to wear _______  ________ in the workshop.
questions.reason: 填safety helmets。safety作名词定语修饰helmets，合起来是安全帽；All workers表示多名工人，通常用复数helmets表达各自佩戴的帽子。be required to wear表示被要求佩戴，不要把safety写成形容词safe而改变搭配。

questions.stem:
They are soldering over there.（改为否定句）
They __________  _________ soldering over there.
questions.reason: 填are not。原句为现在进行时are soldering，变否定只需在be动词后加not，保留soldering。不能加入don't，也不能改为not are；两空完整填are、not，得到They are not soldering over there。

questions.stem:
When you finish the work, you should clear up the machine.（改为被动语态）
When you finish the work, the machine should _________  __________ up.
questions.reason: 填be cleared。原句宾语the machine改作主语，是清理动作的承受者，情态动词被动为should + be + 过去分词。clear变cleared，短语中的up保留在空后；不要写should is cleared或漏掉be。

questions.stem:
The CNC is made in China.（对画线部分提问）
_________  __________ the machine made?
questions.reason: 暂填Where is。若画线处为in China，问产地用Where，原句is made为被动，提问把is放到主语前，得到Where is the machine made?。原文件未显示画线位置，无法完全确定提问对象，故继续待核对，不把这一推定当成唯一依据。
questions.examNote: 原文件未明确显示画线部分；根据 in China 暂按地点提问，须教师核对。

questions.stem:
We had a wonderful time last weekend.（改为同义句）
We _________  _________ last weekend.
questions.reason: 可填enjoyed ourselves或had fun。have a wonderful time、enjoy oneself、have fun均表示玩得愉快；last weekend要求一般过去时。主语We对应反身代词ourselves，不能用themselves；每种参考表达恰好两词，均与原句同义。

questions.stem:
They are very busy repairing the miller.（改为感叹句）
_________  ________ they are repairing the miller!
questions.reason: 参考填How busily。若把busily理解为修饰repairing的方式副词，可用How + 副词 + 主语 + 谓语。原句同时含有be busy doing结构，How busy they are repairing the miller!也可成立，表示他们忙着修机器。因此不能仅凭给定语序排除How busy；讲解时应区分副词修饰动作与形容词busy作表语两种分析。
